content: Next.js basePath (docs, lastUpdated 2025-06-16, v16.3.5 docs): basePath is a build-time value inlined into client bundles; next/link and next/router auto-prefix; next/image and plain /public assets need the prefix added manually. assetPrefix not required when basePath is set. Official nextjs/deploy-github-pages template uses basePath: process.env.PAGES_BASE_PATH with output: 'export', and actions/configure-pages@v5 (static_site_generator not used; base_path output fed as env) — configure-pages set-pages-config.js for 'next' injects output export, basePath (no trailing slash), images.unoptimized true.
